summary: ImplementationDesign correction handoff for BP MCP semantic query contract WP-1 through WP-4. Coding is authorized to repair the real public no-anchor getSystemArchitecture semantic request contract and canonical subset payload mapping while preserving the already passing anchored subset, Relationship endpoint closure, View closure, and full-snapshot compatibility controls.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Public getSystemArchitecture ordinary semantic query carrying forbidden response-shape controls, including the no-anchor callTool and unified MCP tools/call paths.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Anchored and no-anchor requests fail before retrieval with QUERY_RESPONSE_SHAPE_CONTROL_FORBIDDEN and no canonical subset or debug/evidence success.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected RED: no-anchor public semantic query with responseProfile=debug still reaches legacy debug/business-summary behavior instead of failing closed.

explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Both read modes preserve exact canonical full snapshots; graph-tidy reports full-snapshot mode and semantic retrieval bypass.

explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Anchored and no-anchor success payloads expose only canonical document object collections and omit derived semantic/business fields.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected RED: no-anchor public semantic query still exposes legacy business-summary result fields instead of the canonical document subset.

explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Only the canonical matched Element is returned; no adjacent Relationships, endpoint neighbors, or owning Views are added.

codingTargets.failureSignal: reject-response-shape-controls now fails only on the no-anchor public callTool/unified MCP subcases; the legacy debug path is still reachable without anchors.
codingTargets.nextAction: Reject responseProfile/detail/outputMode and debug/full/evidence variants before semantic retrieval for every ordinary semantic query, not only anchor-activated contract fixtures.

codingTargets.failureSignal: canonical-object-subset-only now fails only on the no-anchor public callTool/unified MCP subcases; legacy business-summary result fields are still returned without anchors.
codingTargets.nextAction: Map every ordinary semantic query success to canonical document object subsets by default; do not require query.anchors to activate the canonical subset contract.

codingTargets.failureSignal: broken relationship endpoint fixtures pass instead of failing closed with SEMANTIC_SUBSET_RELATIONSHIP_MISSING.
codingTargets.nextAction: Validate selected Relationship endpoint closure against canonical source/target object presence before returning a successful subset.

codingTargets.failureSignal: broken View member/reference fixtures pass instead of failing closed with SEMANTIC_SUBSET_VIEW_MISSING.
codingTargets.nextAction: Validate selected View members, included Relationships, and in-View endpoints before returning a successful subset.

codingTargets.failureSignal: Public ordinary semantic subset mapping must preserve minimal Relationship endpoint closure and complete non-cascading View closure semantics without reopening default vector retrieval.
codingTargets.nextAction: Implement the BP-MCP-SEM subset mapper and structural validation at the public query boundary; do not modify WP-P2 default retrieval behavior unless a later handoff explicitly authorizes it.

taskExecutionPlan.executionStrategy: Repair in dependency order: request validation first, canonical payload mapping second, relationship endpoint closure third, View membership closure fourth, then run the focused guards and full architecture baseline.

tasks.title: Seal semantic request shape controls
tasks.objective: Make ordinary semantic query requests reject forbidden response-shape controls before retrieval.
steps: Add validation for responseProfile, detail, outputMode, and debug/full/evidence variants in the getSystemArchitecture semantic-query request path for both anchor and no-anchor ordinary queries.
Return stable failure category QUERY_RESPONSE_SHAPE_CONTROL_FORBIDDEN before invoking semantic retrieval; the condition must not depend on query.anchors.
Verify preserve-full-snapshot-read-modes still passes for omitted-query and graph-tidy.
tasks.completionSignal: reject-response-shape-controls passes for both anchor and no-anchor public callTool/unified MCP paths, and preserve-full-snapshot-read-modes remains passing.

tasks.title: Return canonical object subsets only
tasks.objective: Map successful ordinary semantic responses to canonical document object subsets without derived fields or object transformation.
steps: Replace successful semantic result envelope exposure with a document containing only elements, relationships, and views arrays for both anchor and no-anchor ordinary queries.
Deep-copy or select canonical objects by id without dropping, renaming, or adding fields.
Keep Element-only hits minimal unless selected Relationship or selected View closure requires additional canonical objects.
tasks.completionSignal: canonical-object-subset-only passes for both anchor and no-anchor public callTool/unified MCP paths, and element-hit-no-neighbor-expansion remains passing without regressing full-snapshot modes.

tasks.title: Close selected Relationship endpoints
tasks.objective: Return both canonical endpoint Elements for selected Relationships and reject broken endpoint references.
steps: For every selected Relationship, require source_id and target_id to resolve to canonical Element objects from the same selected graph.
Add only the Relationship and both endpoint Elements to the successful canonical subset; do not add endpoint neighbors or endpoint-owned Views.
Return SEMANTIC_SUBSET_RELATIONSHIP_MISSING for unresolved endpoint references before returning a successful subset.

tasks.title: Close selected View membership
tasks.objective: Return complete selected View membership and reject broken View references without overlapping View cascade.
steps: For every selected View, return its canonical View object, all declared included Elements, all declared included Relationships, and endpoints for each included Relationship.
Exclude overlapping Views that only share members unless they independently match or are explicitly selected.
Return SEMANTIC_SUBSET_VIEW_MISSING for unresolved member, included Relationship, or in-View endpoint references before returning a successful subset.

openGaps: No upstream intent graph change is requested.

The scoped correction RED failures are BP-MCP-SEM-REQ and BP-MCP-SEM-PAYLOAD through their no-anchor public callTool/unified MCP subcases; the previously delivered anchored Element, Relationship, View, no-cascade, broken-Relationship, broken-View, and compatibility controls remain frozen regression coverage.

The full pre-coding runner baseline may also contain inherited out-of-scope failures for ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-W3-1-MutationEmbeddingVectorE2E and ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-SP-03-DefaultVectorRetrieval. They are recorded in design/KG/test-failure-records.json when present but are not Coding targets for this correction handoff.
